facts.fact: HiiL says Illimi, a toll-free AI voice companion using a curated knowledge base developed by Niger's Rural Code Directorate, is in pilot in Dosso and Tillaberi, with 863 callers from May to November 2025.

systems.platform: toll-free voice (IVR) with a cloud LLM
systems.owner: National Agency for Legal and Judicial Assistance (ANAJJ)
